hypotheses.name: Charging Port / Sub-Board Mechanical or Pin Fault
recommended_parts: OEM Type-C / Lightning Charging Sub-board Flex
bench_steps: Inspect charging port interior with optical loupe for bent pins, lint, or physical oxidation
Connect USB Ammeter to test current draw (normal 5V/9V fast charge negotiation)
Open back housing and test continuity across the sub-board to main-board interconnect flex
Replace charging sub-board assembly and verify clean 1.5A - 2.4A current draw

hypotheses.name: Charging Management IC / Secondary PMIC Failure (Tristar/Hydra/PM6150/SMB)
bench_steps: Test diode mode value on VBUS pin 1 of motherboard connector (standard 0.450 - 0.650V)
Perform thermal imaging camera sweep with power supply set to 4.2V current limit 1.5A to spot hot PMIC
Shield adjacent CPU/NAND with Kapton thermal tape before micro-soldering heat application
Remove faulty charging controller IC and reball replacement IC with leaded 183°C solder paste

hypotheses.name: Degraded / Internal High-Resistance Lithium Battery Cell
bench_steps: Test open circuit terminal voltage (minimum 3.7V needed to accept charge)
Analyze battery health cycles and internal resistance via diagnostic box (<80% health requires replacement)
Safely release battery stretch adhesive pull tabs without bending or puncturing the lithium pouch
Install new OEM battery, calibrate 0-100% charging cycle, and verify temperature sensors

hypotheses.name: Severely Degraded Bloated / Swollen Lithium Battery (Safety Critical)
bench_steps: DO NOT puncture, bend, or apply direct heat > 60°C to the bloated battery pouch
Use isopropyl alcohol drop softening method along perimeter to loosen adhesive safely
Store degraded swollen cell inside fireproof sand/vermiculite container for safe e-waste disposal
Inspect surrounding display and back glass frame for stress warpage before installing new battery

hypotheses.name: Liquid Corrosion Oxidation & Power Rail Short Circuit
bench_steps: Disconnect battery IMMEDIATELY; do not connect charger or attempt power-on
Remove all board shield cans and inspect under optical microscope for green/white oxide growth
Submerge motherboard in 99.9% Isopropyl Alcohol ultrasonic bath at 40kHz for 8 minutes
Bake motherboard in dry heating oven at 65°C for 45 minutes to eradicate trapped moisture under BGA chips
Test diode mode on VDD_MAIN, V_BAT, and 1.8V Always-On rails; isolate shorted decoupling SMD capacitors
Apply conformal acrylic coating to protect exposed copper traces from future oxidation

hypotheses.name: OLED Matrix / Digitizer Flex Cable Fracture from Drop Impact
recommended_parts: OEM OLED / IPS Display Assembly with Frame
bench_steps: Warm display perimeter on 75°C separation hot plate for 3 minutes
Carefully pry display flex connector and attach a Known-Good OEM test display
Power on device and verify boot logo, color spectrum, 10-point touch grid, and ambient light sensor
Clean housing frame bevel with 0.05mm scraper, apply waterproof perimeter adhesive, and clamp for 30 min

hypotheses.name: Display Backlight Driver IC / Boost Inductor / Filter Blown
bench_steps: Shine bright flashlight at 45° angle onto display; check if faint desktop icons are visible underneath
Check diode mode reading on display connector Backlight Anode pin (normal 0.550V; 0.000V indicates blown diode/short)
Replace burned backlight filter ferrite bead or shorted Schottky diode under microscope
Verify 18V - 24V boost voltage on anode rail under active screen load

hypotheses.name: Primary Power Rail (VDD_MAIN / VBAT) Short Circuit
bench_steps: Connect DC Power Supply to battery terminal set to 4.0V; monitor immediate 1.5A+ draw without pressing power button
Apply rosin smoke or thermal camera to find glowingly hot shorted ceramic decoupling capacitor
Flick off shorted capacitor with micro-tweezers and confirm diode mode recovery to > 0.350V
Replace capacitor with identical capacitance & voltage rating to maintain rail stability

hypotheses.name: AP CPU / LPDDR RAM Solder Ball Joint Fracture (Drop Shock)
bench_steps: Apply moderate thumb pressure directly over CPU shield can while powering device to test intermittent joint contact
Inspect DC power supply boot cycle: stuck at fixed 80mA - 150mA indicates CPU missing handshake with RAM
Perform CNC shield removal or 340°C hot air BGA separation of double-decker RAM layer
Clean pads on AP, reball RAM layer with precision stencil and 183°C solder, resolder to board

hypotheses.name: System OS Firmware Panic / Storage NAND Data Corruption
bench_steps: Put device in DFU / Recovery / Fastboot mode and connect to computer
Extract panic.full logs or dmesg crash logs if accessible to determine kernel panic thread
Execute clean firmware flash with option to retain user data where feasible
If flash aborts at 20% (NAND Error 4013/9), re-route to hardware NAND IC inspection
